'''Dennis Schröder''' ({{IPA-de|ˈʃʀøːdɐ}};<ref>[[wikt:de:Schröder|German Wiktionary]]</ref> born September 15, 1993) is a [[German people|German]] professional [[basketball player]]. He is widely regarded as one of the best talents in German basketball.<ref>[http://www.ndr.de/sport/mehr_sport/schroeder433.html Basketball-Talent Schröder auf Nowitzkis Spuren (in German)]</ref><ref>[http://www.tagesspiegel.de/sport/alba/dennis-schroeder-athlet-und-aushilfsfriseur/7592110.html Dennis Schröder Athlet und Aushilfsfriseur (in German)]</ref>

==Pro career==
In the 2011-12 season, his first professional season, he played 30 games for the New Yorker Phantoms, averaging 2.3 points, 0.7 assists and 0.8 rebounds in about 8 minutes per game.<ref>[http://www.beko-bbl.de/events/top-four/beko-bbl-top-four-2012/news/beko-bbl-top-four-2011/nyp-braunschweig.html Stats 2011-12]</ref>

In the 2012-13 season he played 32 games for the New Yorker Phantoms, averaging 12.0 points, 3.2 assists and 2.5 rebounds in about 25 minutes per game.<ref>[http://www.beko-bbl.de/events/top-four/beko-bbl-top-four-2012/news/beko-bbl-top-four-2011/nyp-braunschweig.html Stats 2012-13]</ref>

In 2013, Schröder was announced to play at the 2013 [[Nike Hoop Summit]] for the World Select Team. Before officially playing at the Nike Hoop Summit, Schröder decided to declare for the [[2013 NBA Draft]].<ref>[http://www.hoopsrumors.com/2013/04/dennis-schroeder-to-enter-draft.html Dennis Schroeder To Enter Draft]</ref> On April 20, 2013, Schröder led his team to a 112-98 win. He finished with 18 points, 6 assists and 2 rebounds in 29 minutes.<ref>[http://www.usabasketball.com/misc/13_hsum_box_score.pdf 2013 Nike Hoop Summit Boxscore]</ref>

==Germany national team==
Schröder has been a member of the [[Germany national basketball team|German national under-18]] and [[Germany national basketball team|German national under-20]] teams. He played in the [[2012 FIBA Europe Under-20 Championship]] and helped the German team to fifth place, averaging 14.6 minutes, 6.1 points, 2.0 assists and 1.8 rebounds.

==Personal life==
Schröder is the son of a German father and a [[Gambia]]n mother. He stated that he started focusing on his basketball career after his father had died in 2010.<ref>[http://www.spiegel.de/sport/sonst/basketball-dennis-schroeder-ueberzeugt-in-braunschweig-a-874647.html  Basketball-Talent Schröder: Aus der Halfpipe in die Bundesliga (in German)]</ref>
